name: IR Japan Holdings,Ltd.
summary: IR Japan Holdings, Ltd., operating mainly through its subsidiary IR Japan, Inc., provides investor relations and shareholder relations consulting to listed companies in Japan. Its equity consulting includes identifying shareholders, simulating votes, assessing the risks of activist shareholders and hostile takeovers, advice on enhancing corporate value, and FA services for acquisitions, integrations and buy-outs. Dating from 1984, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
